title: This site is now a workshop and a journal
summary: I rebuilt this site around what I make and what I'm learning. Projects, short updates, longer writing and a Now page all live in one Git repository, and each has an RSS feed.
whyCare: If you follow along, you'll get dated notes about real progress, with the limits stated, and an easy way to say hello or ask about paid work.
limitations: Draft pages are written to be reviewed before they go live. Nothing here is posted automatically without a check.
